title: Crab Derby, 2006 · before
logline: The day before the twenty-second: Gully at the counter with pen on his forearm — MARIA — 4PM — and Wood at the flyer pretending not to read arms. The strip draws the forearm in the corner of every panel and never mentions it.

panels.composition: The shack. WOOD drawing the flyer. GULLY's forearm on the counter, pen on it, in the panel's corner.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man drawing a flyer at a counter with a stocky man's forearm resting nearby bearing handwriting in pen

panels.composition: GULLY wiping the counter, the forearm in the corner again.

balloons.text: Two crabs. A cup. Nothing new.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a stocky man in an apron wiping a counter with handwriting visible on his forearm

panels.composition: WOOD, inking, the forearm in the corner.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a thin man inking a flyer with a man's inked forearm at the edge of the frame

panels.composition: The finished flyer; the forearm gone out of frame; the clock on the wall at 3:50.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flats, a finished flyer on a counter beneath a wall clock reading ten to four

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: MARIA — 4PM in the corner. Never mentioned.
